notes.title: Astrometica Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Astrometica Launching December 10, 2024! 🚀


The wait is almost over! We’re excited to announce that Astrometica will officially release on December 10, 2024! 🎉

To give you a glimpse of what’s coming, we’ve just released a brand-new trailer:

[previewyoutube=EioCEsGPHj8;full][/previewyoutube]

Mark your calendars, and get ready to embark on an space adventure! Thank you for all your support so far—we can’t wait for you to play the full game. 🌌✨

Stay tuned for more updates as we approach launch day!

notes.title: patch 09632
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

A new patch is available for the Astrometica Prologue! Here are the details:

Bug Fixes:


 Fixed bugs related to building small storage, signs, and power panels on walls.
 Added blocking building zones in some mission locations (blue domes and signal 2).
 Fixed miner tool distance modification bug (modeling bug).
 Resolved loading level issue when saving and loading in the signal 2 location.
 And more.


Improvements and New Additions:


 Added parent build system to all corridors and rooms. Players cannot destroy these structures when something is inside them.
 Implemented performance improvements to reduce game lag.
 Improved material for windows glass
 Added Brazilian language localization.
 Introduced 2 new secrets.
 Made balancing improvements with nickel deposits.
 Improved graphical reflections.
 Added more snap points for door inside corridors

notes.title: patch 09628
notes.notes:
Overriding key binding fix for vehicles: Resolved issues with key bindings not working correctly for vehicles.
 Notification in HUD bug fix: Fixed bugs related to HUD notifications not displaying properly.
 Save lights in old hub station bug fixed: Addressed issues with saving light settings in the old hub station.
 Infinite jetpack bug fixed: Corrected the bug causing the jetpack to have infinite power.

notes.title: New Update/ Steam Open World Event
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're thrilled to announce that we are part of the Open World Survival Crafting Fest on Steam! Your support means the world to us, and we're grateful for the amazing feedback you've shared.

We've gotten some fantastic Reviews and Feedback from you all, and we’re reading every review, both good and bad, to improve the experience for full game as much as possible. Thank you for being such an awesome community!

Here are some exciting stats from the first five days of the prologue release:


 Over 10,000 new wishlists, bringing us close to 50,000 wishlists for Astrometica!
 More than 70,000 players want to play the Astrometica prologue, with 20,000 already installed.
 Over 200 reviews for the prologue, with 95% positive feedback. This is unbelievable and incredibly motivating!


We're also released a new update that includes several bug fixes and new features. Here the patch notes:

Bugs Fixed:


 Fixed crouching animation
 Fixed blueprint in Signal 2 gravity issue
 Added new keybinding for placing builds
 Fixed solar panel model bug
 Fixed bug with consuming food, water, and medkits in vehicles
 Fixed inventory full sound effect issue based on VFX volume
 Fixed bug preventing signs from being deleted
 Fixed gamepad disabling issue after building summon vehicle
 Fixed window rotation bug
 Fixed corridor stair window bug
 Fixed window red ghost bug when placing windows in rooms


New Additions:


 Added snapping system for storages
 Added ability to rotate signs
 Added key bindings for vehicles
 Added gamepad support for vehicles
 Added German localization
 Added new secrets :)
